thread:
matt: Quick check — onboarding mosaic-v2 weights landed in gs://redwood-weights/mosaic-v2/ (checkpoint.pt + tokenizer.json). Seeing odd BOS/EOS behavior in our chat templates; prompts get an extra token at the start and padding seems to inflate. Anyone seen this? cc @olivia @sam

olivia: Are you using the tokenizer.json from the model dir or the one in the repo? small token id mismatches have bitten us before.

sam: Pulled the tokenizer.json from GCS and ran a quick tokenization of the system+user chat template. Got an extra token preceding the system prompt. Looks like bos_token is set but the ids don't line up. Dump:```json
{"special_tokens": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "pad_token": "<pad>"}, "bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2, "pad_token_id": 2}
```Model's embedding index seems to expect BOS=0.

ciara: config-validator caught it: "model_config.bos_token_id (0) != tokenizer.bos_token_id (1)" — pipeline failing on mosaic-v2. Full error: `ConfigValidationError: special token id mismatch`

deploy-bot: CI: config-validator FAILED for mosaic-v2 (gs://redwood-weights/mosaic-v2). See logs: ERROR: bos_token_id mismatch -> blocking release.

jen: Quick options: 1) update model_config to set bos_token_id=1 (fast), 2) update tokenizer.json to make bos_token_id=0 (safer for model assumptions), or 3) add a runtime shim (mapping) in serving config. I'd prefer updating tokenizer.json to match the model semantics and add a sanity test.

alex: I'll open a tiny PR to update tokenizer.json and add a unit that asserts token id alignment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/432 (draft) — tagging @jen for review.

matt: Thanks. Note: our chat template includes an explicit leading `<s>` in some system prompts; changing token ids can shift padding and KV cache offsets. We should coordinate a short rollback plan with runtime team. @ciara can you run a regression eval on ~100 seed prompts after the PR merges? :pray:

ciara: Yup I'll queue the eval once the PR lands. ETA ~2 hours. Will post results in this thread.

sam: Temporary unblock: you can set `pad_token_id = eos_token_id` in the serving config which avoids the extra leading token being treated as meaningful for perf benchmarks. Not ideal long-term but unblocks Dedicated deploys.

matt: Ok let's do that as a temporary mitigation and revert after the tokenizer fix. Also add the weights path to release notes: gs://redwood-weights/mosaic-v2/release-2026-03-17/

olivia: small nit: add a quick entry in the model onboarding checklist to run `python tools/config_validator.py --model-dir gs://...` before tagging for release. Saves this pain. :slightly_smiling_face:

alex: PR opened and CI triggered. I'll ping code-reviewers in the PR and put a short note in the release ticket.

jen: I'll review now. If green, we can merge and let @ciara run the eval.

matt: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for the rollout plan. :thumbsup:

ciara: One more thing: I noticed tokenizer.json had an extra unused special token `<cls>` with id 3; not impacting this bug but I'll remove in the PR too to tidy up.

sam: ack

deploy-bot: CI: config-validator OK after PR #432 merge (simulated) — please run full CI before final cutover.
